transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. AI. What brings you in today?

I can’t shake this feeling that I’m useless now and just letting everyone down since my fall. I had an unexpected knee procedure a few weeks ago, and my primary doctor referred me here because I just haven't been able to get past these feelings. It has been really hard to cope with not being able to do what I used to.
Since the fall and knee procedure, have you also had a persistent depressed mood or loss of interest in things most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?

Yes, I've felt this low constantly for about a month now, ever since it became clear I wasn't bouncing back. I've completely lost interest in the things that used to light me up, like my financial workshops, hiking, and gardening. I just feel this blank indifference now and end up sitting in front of the TV instead.
Over the past month, have you also had changes in sleep, appetite, energy, concentration, or any thoughts that life isn’t worth living?

Yes, I'm struggling with all of those—I lie awake worrying at night, have to force myself to eat, and feel so heavy and exhausted that even taking a shower is a struggle. My mind is constantly foggy, and lately, I've had quiet thoughts that it might just be easier if I didn't wake up one morning.
Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself or making a plan to end your life?

No, I haven't made any plans to harm myself or do anything to end my life. I just sometimes think it wouldn't be so bad if I didn't wake up, or if I could just slip away so things would be quiet for everyone. But I don't have any actual plans to do anything.
